name: Procrea Holdings Inc
summary: Procrea Holdings, Inc. functions as a parent organization for The Aomori Bank, Ltd. and The Michinoku Bank, Ltd., through which it provides a comprehensive range of banking solutions. Its services include issuing credit cards, offering credit guarantees, and handling credit management and collection. The company also diversifies its activities into consulting, leasing, and property management. Founded in 2022, its main corporate office is located in Aomori, Japan.
